hints.title: Use the ordering
hints.body: If the middle value is too small, the target can only be to the right; if too large, only to the left.

hints.title: Maintain a half-open interval
hints.body: Search `[low, high)`. While `low < high`, compare the middle element with the target.

hints.title: Shrink one side
hints.body: Move `low` to `middle + 1` when the middle is too small, otherwise move `high` to `middle`.

hints.title: Pseudocode
hints.body:
```
low = 0, high = length(nums)
while low < high:
    middle = low + (high - low) // 2
    if nums[middle] == target: return middle
    if nums[middle] < target: low = middle + 1
    else: high = middle
return -1
```

This is pseudocode, not a complete solution.
